dialogues.speaker: Mihir
dialogues.text: The sights and scenes of the Vourukasha Oasis are as they always were. They comfort you humans as well, yes?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Pari responsibilities...

dialogues.speaker: Mihir
dialogues.text: These should come naturally to us Pari, and should not trouble us.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Sorush...

dialogues.speaker: Mihir
dialogues.text: Sorush is also doing her utmost to fulfill her duties as a Pari.

dialogues.speaker: Mihir
dialogues.text: Although her methods... could use some refinement, she is very dedicated to her duties. I am sure you understand what I mean.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll leave you in peace for now.

dialogues.speaker: Mihir
dialogues.text: Very well. I shall stay here for a spell.

dialogues.speaker: Mihir
dialogues.text: Peace has been restored for now... Friendly human, why are you still here?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There are still some other things I'd like to do...

dialogues.speaker: Mihir
dialogues.text: If such is the case, I understand.

dialogues.speaker: Mihir
dialogues.text: I also have many tasks awaiting me... I will complete them after I finish resting.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Sorush...

dialogues.speaker: Mihir
dialogues.text: In terms familiar to a human, Sorush has matured from her recent experiences.

dialogues.speaker: Mihir
dialogues.text: The Pari are indifferent to the maturation process, but I didn't realize that Sorush had already...

dialogues.speaker: Mihir
dialogues.text: Hm. It's been a good thing for her. That should mean enough.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the Sign of Apaosha...

dialogues.speaker: Mihir
dialogues.text: Considering a lot of what happened was pretty unexpected... Well, unexpected for Sorush, anyhow.

dialogues.speaker: Mihir
dialogues.text: With the sign extinguished, I assume Sorush has also learned much from the Chaplet.

dialogues.speaker: Mihir
dialogues.text: The greater struggle itself, however, is not over. As Pari, our duty remains even with the quelling of the sign.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Nothing. I'll be going now.

dialogues.speaker: Mihir
dialogues.text: Farewell, friendly human.
